profit_quality.assessment: 2024 reported profit is real but not fully distributable: operating cash flow was HK$150.529m versus parent net profit HK$170.373m, and HK$53.342m was absorbed by inventory. 2023 cash conversion was stronger, but using that year alone would overstate the denominator. adjustments: Use recent profit base: 2022-2024 parent net profit was HK$172.553m, HK$175.420m and HK$170.373m; median is about HK$172.553m.
Remove/discount treasury and non-operating gains because excess funds are treated separately: bank deposit interest, FVTPL income/gains, dividend income, FX gains and lease termination gain.
Cross-check against 2024 operating free cash flow of HK$127.733m after HK$22.796m PPE capex.
Set pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit at HK$140m, then apply 0.70 haircut.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 OCF/net profit ratio 0.88; 2024 FCF HK$127.733m. 2023 OCF was HK$273.238m, but this benefited from working-capital movement and is not used as the main denominator.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Manufacturing business has real cash generation but 2024 inventory build, customer concentration, trade financing needs during the year and overseas factory expansion reduce the amount that can be treated as steady owner-distributable cash.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Medium: one weak conversion year after a strong year; current annual report gives only two-year cash-flow details.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Use 2024 PPE purchases HK$22.796m as conservative current capex burden; Cambodia/Vietnam/Honduras expansion means part may be growth capex but it is still cash needed to sustain near-term business plan.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital consumed cash mainly through HK$53.342m inventory increase; this is reflected in the haircut rather than ignored.
